minor_issues: The mobile header timestamp breaks across lines in the middle of the date.
At 1440 px, the Approved filter wraps onto a second row, leaving unused space beside it and pushing the queue down.
strengths: The desktop layout clearly distinguishes the review queue from the selected specification, with consistent alignment and ample spacing.
Risk and status use readable text alongside color, and the selected queue item is easy to identify.
At 390 px, the search field, summary metrics, and filters fit within the viewport, and long queue titles wrap cleanly.
summary: The three screenshots meet the visual quality floor. No major defects are visible. The mobile screenshot covers only the top of the page, so the specification detail layout on mobile remains unverified.
